label: Whatever is CREATURE_2 is CREATURE_1, legacy statement by instantiation
meaning: Transcription by instantiation: the sense-fixed bridge gives the Creature-parametric legacy statement 'Whatever is CREATURE_2 (caused in being by another) is CREATURE_1' with Creature instantiated at the CREATURE_1 constant (the two say the same; causedInBeingByAnotherIsCreature_iff). It lets the registered Round 2 chain, which binds the legacy statement, rest on the derived bridge. It adds no content and is not progress on its own; the legacy statement closes exactly when the sense-fixed bridge does.
